description: This PHP class `AddressFormat` within the `Opencart\u2026` namespace provides a method to retrieve address format records from the database based on an address format ID. It is part of the model layer handling localisation address formats in the Opencart system.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: Handles retrieval of address format data from the database in the Opencart localisation module.

methods.name: getAddressFormat
methods.description: Retrieves an address format record from the database given its ID.
